name: @legiscore/sdk
description: Node SDK for the LegiScore partner API — legal opinion reports and government record searches.
author: LawyerDesk Advocacy Pvt Ltd <info@legiscore.in>

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/write-cjs-package.mjs dist/cjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test dist/test/test/*.test.js && npm run test:esm && npm run test:cjs
scripts.test:esm: node --input-type=module -e "import * as sdk from './dist/esm/index.js'; if (typeof sdk.LegiScore !== 'function' || typeof sdk.verifyWebhook !== 'function') throw new Error('ESM entry point is missing an export');"
scripts.test:cjs: node -e "const sdk = require('./dist/cjs/index.js'); if (typeof sdk.LegiScore !== 'function' || typeof sdk.verifyWebhook !== 'function') throw new Error('CJS entry point is missing an export');"
